newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end at new closing high.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end at new closing high.

text.p: Jakarta's composite index ended at a record closing high on Monday on active local buying of secondaries and modest interest in blue-chips, brokers said.
The index closed 1.04 percent, or 7.41 points, higher at 719.64 points after touching a intra-day high of 719.79 points only minutes earlier, they said.
The previous closing high of 717.47 points was recorded on February 27, 1997.
In the broader market, gainers led losers by 78 to 54, with 75 counters unchanged. Total turn-over was estimated at 460 billion rupiah.

"Today's rise is quite surprising. It seems the index will continue gaining on Tuesday on possible continued buying by local investors," an analyst with a major state-owned securities firm said, adding that foreign investors might join the trend.
He attributed the sharp rise in the index to active local buying in secondary stocks and said by the strong rise on Wall Street on Friday contributed to the firm sentiment.
"Trading had been slow recently and pyschologically investors wanted to break that," said Suharto, a broker with Bhakti Investama brokerage.
He said there was a perception that it was the right time to buy secondaries because rumours were floating of stock splits, dividend payments and rights issues.
Small garment firm Karwell topped the active list with 12 million shares traded, rising 75 rupiah to 1,200 rupiah.
